summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing proposed amendments to its CAD $1.0 million convertible debenture and warrants. The amendments include capitalizing CAD $120,000 of accrued interest, extending the maturity and conversion period to June 30, 2028, and reducing the conversion price from CAD $1.25 to CAD $1.00 per share. The warrant expiry is also extended to June 30, 2028. The changes are subject to TSX Venture Exchange acceptance. This is a routine debt restructuring, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
